In this section of *Aj Jaya The Real Practice*, the Dhamma is brought to life: *"Similarly, the Vinaya  rules and the observances give you a grid in which you can co nstantly be returning to the present moment and keeping track o f what you are doing with your body, how you are speaking, how  you are acting."*. It is like a clean, untinted mirror: it reflects green when green comes and red when red comes, without retaining any color when the object departs. When you hold this simile in your heart during practice, it provides an immediate reference point for letting go and realizing unburdened clarity.
